Right angle at \(F_1\):
\[
(P-F_1)\cdot(F_2-F_1)=0 \implies x=-\sqrt2
\]
On the ellipse: \(y=\pm 1\), giving 2 points.

Right angle at \(F_2\):
\[
(P-F_2)\cdot(F_1-F_2)=0 \implies x=\sqrt2
\]
On the ellipse: \(y=\pm 1\), giving 2 points.

Right angle at \(P\):
\[
(P-F_1)\cdot(P-F_2)=0 \implies x^2+y^2=2
\]
Intersecting with the ellipse gives \(x=0,\ y=\pm\sqrt2\), giving 2 points.

Total:
\[
2+2+2=6
\]

\boxed{6}
